name: ai-automation-results-v2
target: Участник сам внедрил ИИ или автоматизацию в бизнес-процесс и описал измеримый результат

ai_business.instructions: Does the author say that they personally built or deployed an AI tool or automation that is already running and used for a business task? Answer no for plans, questions, discussion of tools made by other people, announcements, and AI-generated text pasted as an answer.

criteria.true: A finished automation or AI tool the author made is in use for a business task (sales, CRM, documents, support, accounting, reports, integration with company systems).
criteria.false: Planned or unfinished work, questions, complaints, discussion of tools made by others, news, or AI-generated text pasted as an answer (for example a list of answers for a developer).

measurable_result.instructions: Does the author report a measurable result: time saved, cost reduced, revenue, number of items processed, or a percentage improvement?

criteria.true: A specific number or clearly quantified benefit is stated.

category.instructions: Which area does the automation belong to?

criteria.documents: Documents, scans, contracts, PDF or Word files.
